integrity: The original algorithm, earlier tail guarantees and observed multi-trial exponent are attributed to the motivating publication. Exact constants are derived in the associated proof. Independent mathematical priority or validation has not been established.
scientific_limitations: Proved for one specified two-by-two symmetric family, Gaussian independent coefficient draws, best-of-trials orthogonal eigenbases, exact arithmetic, and expected squared off-diagonal Frobenius loss. Does not classify other algorithms, general dimensions, or floating-point behavior.
title: Exact restart-moment frontier for two-by-two randomized joint diagonalization
